method: Windows ping.exe; Jetson 12 requests then gateway 8 requests; 32-byte payload; 1000 ms timeout

viewer_wifi.adapter: MediaTek Wi-Fi 6E MT7922 (RZ616) 160MHz Wireless LAN Card

limitations: Sequential short ping samples; not a long-term packet loss estimate.
ICMP timing cannot identify RF interference, driver power saving, AP forwarding or host scheduling individually.
Wi-Fi link rate is not measured application throughput.
